routes.name: Haji Camp - Karkhano Market

sources.title: Urbanscape: A farewell to wagons

routes.notes: Ford wagon route, 40+ years old; ran via Khyber Road until ~2000, then via Sher Shah Suri Road joining University Road at Gora Qabristan. Dawn (Jul 2019): about 640 wagons, down to ~200, being withdrawn with compensation for the Peshawar BRT; probably no longer running. Karkhano Market coordinate is the OSM BRT-station way used in peshawar-sindh-quetta.json. Wagons were withdrawn from the BRT corridor from 2019; kept as an old route.

routes.name: Haji Camp Adda - Kohat Adda

sources.title: Kohat Bus Stand Peshawar (listing)

routes.notes: Undated directory listing says a connecting vehicle service runs between Haji Camp Adda and Kohat Adda; vehicle type not stated (the listing mentions Suzukis and rickshaws for local connections). Endpoints only, no intermediate stops. Not known whether it still runs after BRT; Haji Camp is on the BRT corridor, but the link toward Kohat Road is off-corridor. Check for overlap with any BRT feeder route before adding.

sources.title: RTA Peshawar Notification/Fare Table No. 286-310/RTA/PESH dated 01/04/2024, serial 1 (section 'Kohat Road Peshawar')

routes.notes: Serial 1 of the RTA Peshawar diesel fare table (111 routes, w.e.f. 01-04-2024), listed under 'District Peshawar / Kohat Road Peshawar'. Official stage-carriage route (terminal and destination only; no intermediate stops, no vehicle type split beyond fare class). Route id is ours (serial number). Fares are from the April 2024 diesel price and have since been revised (Mar 2026 per-km rates), so treat as historical fare. Route still plausibly operated by private minibuses/wagons/coaches; not field-verified. Printed as 'GBS GT Road' although grouped under Kohat Road; Badaber..Sherkara lie on Kohat Road, so the origin may be the Kohat Road GBS.
